svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider
svg.desc: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider. 12 components in 10 groups. Connections: Okta to AWS Cloud (SAML); Okta to Google Cloud (OIDC); Okta to Microsoft Entra tenant (SAML); Amazon EKS to Direct Connect gateway; Direct Connect gateway to AWS Direct Connect; BigQuery to Cloud Router (Private Google Access); Cloud Router to Partner Interconnect; Azure App Service to Private endpoint (Private Link); Private endpoint to ExpressRoute gateway; ExpressRoute gateway to Azure ExpressRoute; AWS Direct Connect to Colocation router (private VIF); Partner Interconnect to Colocation router (VLAN attachment); Azure ExpressRoute to Colocation router (private peering).

text.tspan: MULTI-CLOUD WITH A SHARED IDENTITY PROVIDER
One Okta tenant signs users in to AWS, Google Cloud and Azure; private interconnects meet at a colocation router
